title: Part Seven: The Black Nobility and the Orsini

sections.brief: What the nobiltà nera was (1870, closed doors; a social allegiance, not an organization); hereditary court offices and the Noble Guard; Colonna, Massimo, Torlonia, Pacelli records; Lateran Concordat Art. 42 and Treaty Arts. 9-10 (titles confirmed, not abolished, in 1929; no noble citizenship clause); R.D. 974/1930; 1948 Constitution and Corte cost. 101/1967; Pontificalis Domus 1968, Noble Guard abolished 1970, Pallavicini-Lefebvre 1977; 'families that owned the papacy' rejected. Figures: fig-time

Orsini origins and legends; three popes (Celestine III, Nicholas III, Benedict XIII), not five (Nicholas IV Masci, Leo XIII Pecci, Boniface VIII Caetani, Honorius III, Clement XIII Rezzonico); none since 1730; 34 cardinals as reported; 1305 conclave with Orsini on both sides; Chinon cardinals; Bracciano sold before 1698, Gravina line; 1823 marriage corrected; living head by published genealogy only, no office; myths graded: control of the papacy, Orsini = Rothschild (with the antisemitic history of the trope), Grey Pope / Committee of 300. Figures: fig-compare (claim vs record)

Prince Assistant to the Papal Throne: 1511 origin, duties, Benedict XIII's Orsini-Colonna alternation, Orsini 1735-1958; Filippo Orsini and Belinda Lee, removal by Pius XII Jan 1958 (TIME 10 Feb 1958; the thread's TIME 1959 not located); Torlonia 1958 or 1962 (disputed); Pontificalis Domus 28 March 1968 ('nullum munus hereditarium'); Colonna d. 1987, Torlonia d. Dec 2017; 1929-abolition and 'catalyst' claims rejected; no family holds an office at the Holy See as of October 2026. Figures: fig-time, fig-compare
